systems.tiers: national; enrolment of asylum-seekers approved, to be implemented in 2025

systems.owner: DAARA (Direction d'Aide et d'Assistance aux Réfugiés et Apatrides), with UNHCR

note: A UNHCR response plan report: refugee registration and planned enrolment in the population register (class identity); 181 asylum-seeking children were helped to obtain birth certificate extracts and 5,014 people assisted with civil status documents in 2024, with nothing on how offices record events.
